recommendation: Keep the audit commit. No core follow-up is needed; if Transport returns to core or changes in OO Incubator, preserve Transport.description as markdown there.
issue_request: FHIR-39594 is an Applied/Persuasive OO change request for R6 asking that Transport.description use markdown because the free-text description may be lengthy.
initial_application: HL7/fhir PR #3660 changed source/transport/structuredefinition-Transport.xml from string to markdown for Transport.description. The local implementation commit f98cc499514637b58624cfda9203ea84f527ba1c contains the correct patch but its body accidentally references unrelated FHIR-51840.
additional_context: FHIR-38714 is the upstream markdown datatype clarification cited by the issue. Later commit 3b38b80cf23f9cbb306fab8fcedb293315478c32 removed Transport from active core fhir.ini resource sections and core narrative now points to the OO Incubator artifact. The current OO Incubator StructureDefinition-Transport.json also declares Transport.description as markdown; no Zulip evidence was found that conflicts with Jira, PR, source, and OO minutes.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No core source edit was made because the requested change is already present in the remaining inactive core source and in the active external Transport definition.

related_jiras.note: Established markdown datatype semantics and the compatibility of converting string elements to markdown when longer text is expected.
